examples.pie: déh₂nu gʷm̥tóm? déh₂nu ne gʷm̥tóm wódr̥-kʷe HeHḱú. pértum h₁idʰí. pértus kúdʰe h₁ésti? pértus h₂énti h₁ésti.
examples.en: "Is the river passable?" "The river is not passable, and the water is swift. Go to the crossing!" "Where is the crossing?" "The crossing is near."

examples.pie: nu déh₂nu téwe wódr̥ stoh₂éye h₁mé mē lémbʰs. nu wódr̥ bʰérǵʰu mē h₁syéh₁t h₁íd gʷm̥tóm h₁syéh₁t. nu péroh₂ nu-kʷe h₂én stéh₂oh₂. méne h₁éḱwōs prih₁ént déh₃rom toy h₁áyoh₂.
examples.en: Now, river, make your water stand! Do not seize me! May the water not be high; may it be passable! Now I shall cross, and I shall stand on the other side. May my horses cross; I shall give you a gift.

examples.pie: gʷm̥tós péruns stéyks kʷór h₁ésti? déh₂newi h₂én h₁ésti. nékʷti mē h₁éys. pérwr̥ méǵh₂ wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe h₂én tḱiyénti. h₁éymos ne dedwóyh₂e péh₂wr̥-kʷe bʰéroh₂. sóh₂wl̥ twé wédʰoyh₁t.
examples.en: "Where is the passable path of the mountain?" "It is there, by the river. Do not go in the night. The mountain is great, and wolves live there." "I am not afraid of them, and I carry fire. May the sun lead you."

examples.pie: só mr̥tós h₁ésti? só mr̥tós ne h₁ésti. h₂énh₁ti.
examples.en: Is he dead? He is not dead. He breathes.

examples.pie: Hyudʰsmós h₂énh₁t mért-kʷe só.
examples.en: The warrior breathed, and he died.

examples.pie: h₂éwh₂e wetsós ǵeǵónh₁e ne sth₂éh₁yeti. h₂énh₁ti? h₂énh₁ti h₁ésyo skélesh₂ ml̥dúh₂. h₁ím tl̥h₂dʰí h₁ím-kʷe gʷṓm próti bʰére. h₁yód dʰéh₁yēti sth₂éh₁yēti. nu dʰéh₁yeti gʷṓws-kʷe h₁ím léyǵʰti. gʷṓws swóm téḱnom ǵn̥néh₃ti.
examples.en: Uncle, the calf has been born, but it does not stand. Is it breathing? It breathes, but its legs are weak. Lift it, and carry it to the cow. If it sucks, it will stand. Now it is sucking, and the cow licks it! A cow knows her young.

examples.pie: wĺ̥kʷe kú yéh₂si? h₂ówins h₁éymi. mē yéh₂s. poh₂imḗn bʰéwdʰeti h₂ówins-kʷe péh₂smi.
examples.en: "Wolf, where are you going?" "I am going to the sheep." "Do not go! The shepherd is awake, and I am guarding the sheep."

examples.pie: h₁regʷesyéti. h₂éǵmn̥ kú h₁ésti? h₂éǵmn̥ h₂éǵroy h₁ésti. h₂éǵmn̥ ḱóymom h₂éǵe ḱwónm̥-kʷe géwHe. h₁íd h₂éǵoh₂.
examples.en: "It is getting dark. Where is the flock?" "The flock is in the field." "Drive the flock home, and call the dog." "I drive it."

examples.pie: kʷís gʰóstey túH? h₁eǵóh₂ h₂ŕ̥tḱosyo suHnús h₁nómn̥-kʷe moy pérkʷus. pérkʷew kú h₁éysi? h₃rēǵés dṓm yéh₂mi. gʷh₂dʰí.
examples.en: "Who are you, stranger?" "I am the son of Bear, and my name is Oak." "Where are you going, Oak?" "I am going to the house of the king." "Go!"

examples.pie: h₂énHe snóygʷʰos gʷegʷóme. h₁éǵʰs h₁éyomes lóygōmes-kʷe? h₁ité woséyedʰwe-kʷe. h₁idʰé wékʷsperōd préy h₁sté. kʷíd h₁idʰé h₁ésomes? kʷséps ǵʰiméni móḱs gʷm̥yéti wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe ml̥h₃ént. h₁idʰé wékʷsperōd préy h₁ésomes.
examples.en: Grandmother, the snow has come! Shall we go out and play? Go, and clothe yourselves! Be here before evening. Why shall we be here? In winter the night comes quickly, and the wolves come forth. We will be here before evening!

examples.pie: deywṓm h₁nómn̥h₂ wóydth₂e? h₁íh₂ wóydh₂e. h₁n̥gʷnís nos ḱóymoy tḱéyti. nébʰtus wédn̥su tḱéyti. kʷóm deywóm lubʰyési? h₂éwsosm̥ lubʰyóh₂. h₁íh₂ Héh₂mr̥ bʰéreti.
examples.en: Do you know the names of the gods? I know them. Fire dwells in our home. The water god dwells in the waters. Which god do you love? I love Dawn. She brings the daylight.

examples.pie: nébʰtew h₂ékʷeh₂s pótey ḱludʰí. tébʰye gʷʰermóm h₂mélǵos sikʷmé. h₁yós déh₂newi tḱéysi dóh₃r̥ nos h₁áyso. péḱu nos toy h₂ékʷeh₂m píph₃oyh₁t. suHnúns nos déh₂newi mē h₁éps.
examples.en: Nebhtus, master of the water, hear! To you we have poured the warm milk. You who dwell in the river, receive our gift. May our livestock drink your water. Do not seize our sons in the river.

examples.pie: kʷíd h₂élbʰit? h₁íd ǵr̥h₂nóm. h₁íd wésni séh₁yomes h₁íd-kʷe sh₁séni kh₂éydomes. h₁éḱwōs h₂élbʰit h₁édn̥ti? h₁íd h₁édn̥ti ugʷsénes-kʷe h₁íd éti h₁édn̥ti.

examples.en: In the house of Boar there are two horses, three bulls, seven sheep, and a piglet. In the field of Crane are a hundred sheep. Boar said: "Your flock is big. May Perkʷunos guard it."

examples.pie: h₁mé spéḱye. pérkʷum kapyóh₂. h₁ím skinédmi. h₁ím h₃roǵéyoh₂. nu gʷéru wr̥ǵdʰí. h₃reǵtóm tworḱóm gʷʰénti. h₁yód te tworḱós próti drémeti. sth₂dʰí h₁íd-kʷe tetl̥h₂dʰí. h₁íd ḱwónm̥ mē Hyéh₁ks.

examples.en: The sky is dark. Will it rain? It will rain; drive the cattle to the stall. Are the oxen afraid of the rain? They are afraid when Perkunos roars.

examples.pie: wr̥h₁dʰí moy kʷíd h₁éḱwos h₂élgʷʰeti? h₁wésus h₁éḱwos déḱm̥ ugʷsénn̥s h₂élgʷʰeti. kʷíd pṓlHos h₂élgʷʰeti? pṓlHos pénkʷe h₂egʷnóns h₂élgʷʰeti.
examples.en: Tell me, what is a horse worth? A good horse is worth ten oxen. What is a foal worth? A foal is worth five lambs.

examples.pie: kúdʰe toy ph₂tḗr h₁ésti? h₂éǵrom ugʷsn̥bʰís h₂érh₃yeti. dʰéǵʰōm h₂susyéti? h₂susyéti. ne h₂wérst. móḱs h₂wr̥syéh₁t. dyḗws te ph₂tḗr ḱluyéh₁t.
